none: PAS SWYOR-44888C: Roman ToT finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver Roman finger ring, inscribed "ToT", of Henig Type XI, dating from AD 43 - 300. The ring has a flat rectangular bezel with tapering shoulders and narrowed hoop. The bezel is decorated with a rectangle formed of punched dots linked by a line. Within the rectangle are the inscribed letters "ToT".
